notes.title: Limited-time Major Themed Event [Interstice of Reminiscence]
notes.content: [p]- New Event -[/p][p]Limited-time Major Themed Event \[Interstice of Reminiscence][/p][p]Participate in the event to obtain rich rewards such as \[Collapse Pieces], \[Targeted Access Permissions], and \[Basic Info Cores]![/p][p]During this version, participate in sign-in events and complete event tasks to receive additional rewards, including Mosin-Nagant's Outfit - \[Siberian Slide] and 30 pulls![/p][p]- New Doll -[/p][p]Elite Doll \[Belka] and \[Andoris] available through limited-time Targeted Procurement.[/p][p]- New Weapon -[/p][p]Elite Weapon \[Sylvan Elf] and \[Aglaea] available through limited-time Military Upgrade.[/p][p]- Returning Doll -[/p][p]Elite Doll \[Zhaohui] available through limited-time Targeted Procurement.[/p][p]- New Outfits -[/p][p]Qiongjiu's Outfit - \[Pinnacle of Virtue] [/p][p]Belka's Outfit - \[Enchanting Imp] [/p][p]Accessory Variants of Sharkry's Outfit - \[Swimsuit Idol][/p][p]Mosin-Nagant's Outfit - \[Siberian Slide] can be obtained by completing limited-time event tasks.[/p][p]- New Game Mode - [/p][p]\[Coordination Drill] EX-2: Hurricane Season[/p][p]*For other update details, please refer to in-game announcements.[/p]

notes.title: Limited-time Themed Event [EX UMBRA]
notes.content:
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]- New Event -
Limited-time Themed Event \[EX UMBRA]
Participate in the event to obtain rich rewards such as \[Collapse Pieces], \[Targeted Access Permissions], and \[Basic Info Cores]!

- New Doll -
Elite Doll \[Nikketa]
Nikketa is a Sentinel-class Doll capable of outputting a lot of damage through repeated usage of her Ultimate skill. Available through limited-time Targeted Procurement.

- New Weapon -
Elite Weapon \[Guardian Silverwing]
A high-performance rifle assigned to Nikketa. Its shooting precision has been upgraded, turning it into the ultimate tool for protecting justice. Available through limited-time Military Upgrade.

- Returning Doll -
Elite Doll \[Yoohee] available through limited-time Targeted Procurement.

- New Outfits -
Nikketa's Outfit - \[Dance Like the Blazing Sun] 
Accessory Variants of Suomi's Outfit - \[Sparkling Ocean]

*For other update details, please refer to in-game announcements.[/p][/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Limited-time Major Themed Event [Mímisbrunnr's Loop]
notes.content:
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]  [b]- New Event -[/b] [/p][p]Limited-time Major Themed Event \[Mímisbrunnr's Loop] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311021/1216eec69634e396db74ec5eeba43c0eb7a441c3.png"][/img][/p][p]At the edge of a world of darkness, lies the sole key to victory. Stand strong until the very end, and the light of dawn will emerge. Commanders and Doll squads will face new challenges. Participate in the event to obtain rich rewards such as \[Collapse Pieces], \[Targeted Access Permissions], and \[Basic Info Cores]!
